notesForReviewer: Exactly 10 titles were investigated per the manifest verification requirement -- none were missing from the 84-title manifest, so none were substituted.

Of the 10, 6 required a genuinely new override (Stick it to the Man!, For the King, New Gundam Breaker, Sparklite, Flashback, Firefighters: The Simulation) because no override previously existed to supersede their contaminated base shelfcheck-dossiers.txt entry.

The remaining 4 (Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker, Gundam Versus, Nexomon: Extinction, Inertial Drift) already had an accurate, game-specific override in an earlier batch (15 or 16) that already supersedes the contaminated base entry at runtime -- Josh has never actually seen the contaminated text for these 4. Each was independently re-verified for accuracy against the actual game and left untouched, per the instruction to repair only what's actually broken rather than rewrite good dossiers.

All 6 new entries live in a new file, dossier-overrides-46.js, following the exact same object-literal {t,s,w,c,r,b,p} schema as the most recent existing batch (45). No existing dossier-overrides-*.js file was edited.

dossier-apply.js, index.html, and sw.js each received exactly one minimal line-edit to register/precache the new batch file (consistent with how every prior batch was wired in); sw.js's cache generation was bumped shelfcheck-v135 -> shelfcheck-v136 since the precache list changed.
